- `ArrayStoreException` is thrown if the runtime type of the provided array is not a supertype of the runtime type of every element in the collection. In the code, the array is created with the type `ProgressListener[]`, which is the same as the type of elements in `progressListeners`. Therefore, this exception is avoided.

- `NullPointerException` is thrown if the array passed to `toArray` is null. In the code, the array is created with `new ProgressListener[progressListeners.size()]`, which ensures that the array is not null. Therefore, this exception is also avoided.
